scientific_integrity: Exact moment identities are algebraically proved and separately checked for every graph through six vertices at three rational probabilities. No independent scientific validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: For independent-edge G(n,p) only; correlation limits are pointwise for fixed lambda, not a growing-dimensional CLT. Other general induced-subgraph coefficient formulas may yield the specialized result after explicit calculation; earlier literature priority is incompletely resolved. Complete text of Janson (1990) was inaccessible.
title: Critical-window correlation reversal between triangles and induced four-cycles
